title: Deep Sea Anglerfish
subtitle: Bathypelagic Esca Photophore & Needle Jaw Array
description: Bathypelagic ceratioid anglerfish featuring a flexible sinusoidal illicium rod, a pulsating blue-green luciferin photophore lure, and needle-sharp interlocking teeth.
mathNotation: \mathbf{p}_{\text{esca}}(t) = \mathbf{p}_{\text{root}} + \mathbf{R}(\theta_{\text{rod}}) \begin{bmatrix} L_x + A_x \sin(\omega_1 t) \\ L_y + A_y \cos(\omega_2 t) \end{bmatrix}, \quad I_{\text{glow}} = I_0 \left[ 1 + \alpha \sin(\omega_{\text{pulse}} t) \right]
formulaCompact: esca = root + [85 + sin(2.5t)*22, -95 + cos(2t)*16],  glow = radialGradient(esca, 12 * (1 + 0.3*sin(4t)))
